name: design-doc
description: Technical design docs, product proposals, and RFCs: a written argument for a decision, with a stated problem, a proposed approach, and consequences for people other than the author.

brief_fields.name: what_it_is
brief_fields.label: What it is
brief_fields.prompt: What's this doc proposing, in one or two sentences?

brief_fields.name: audience
brief_fields.label: Audience
brief_fields.prompt: Who's this written for — engineers, execs, cross-functional reviewers?

brief_fields.name: decision_authority
brief_fields.label: The ask
brief_fields.prompt: What decision or approval is this doc trying to get, and from whom?

brief_fields.name: prior_art
brief_fields.label: Prior art
brief_fields.prompt: Related docs, past decisions, or precedent this builds on or departs from?

brief_fields.name: constraints
brief_fields.label: Constraints
brief_fields.prompt: Budget, timeline, org, or technical constraints shaping the proposal?

brief_fields.name: known_open_questions
brief_fields.label: Known open questions
brief_fields.prompt: What's deliberately left unresolved in this draft?

draft_stages.name: early draft / brainstorm
draft_stages.implication: Structure only. No line-level findings — the argument isn't settled yet.

draft_stages.name: first complete draft
draft_stages.implication: Developmental focus. Line findings only if major+ or a pattern across sections.

draft_stages.name: under review
draft_stages.implication: Both layers in full, normal severity calibration.

draft_stages.name: final before submission
draft_stages.implication: Both layers, and minor findings become worth reporting.
